tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sha brgya zan brgya'i glud gzhung srid zhi sbyin mchod bzhugs so// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ de la 'dir/ snyigs 'gro log 'dren nyer 'tshe las bsrung phyir gu ru rin po ches rgya bod mtshams su mdzad cing zangs yag brag tu gter du sbas pa gu ru jo tshes bton pa'i sha brgya zan brgya'i glud rang re sa lugs kyi lag len byed tshul ni/ bla ma yi dam gang rung gi dbang thob cing gzhi bsnyen mthar phyin pa yi dam chos srung gi gtor bsngo bskang ba shes pa zhig gi rang gzhan rim gror/ 'di nyid nyams su len tshul ni/ snod min gyi dben pa'i gnas su/ dam rdzas bskang gtor rgyas bsdus ci rigs mchod pa phud chang bcas/ de'i mdun phyar ba nag po yo byad rnams shong tshod kyi khud steng ste/ glud bsgrub bya'i gzugs ser skya pho mo cha lugs gang byed de bzo bas/ zhon khal sogs kyi rim gro rkyang pa yin na glud mi gzugs mi byed par/ rta drel/ mdzo g.yag bong bu/ rnga mong sogs sam/ gzhan yang ba glang ra lug 'bri khyi lta bu gang bcol yang dbyibs cha lugs sems can rang rang la thod pa de bzos mthar gser dngul sogs rin po che'i bsres pa'i thum bu dar gos yug gzugs/ ja 'khor/ mar do/ stong gzugs du ma/ snam ras/ lcang shing 'bras sman sogs kyi rdzas mang po/ rta drel sogs bzhon khal mang po/ sga khal cha 'grigs sogs mdor na longs spyod zas gos nyer spyad dran tshad bzos 'thus pas de bzhin ci nus stabs gang bder spungs mthar/ de dag gi shar du bag zan gyi spre'u dkor khal bkal ba keng rus kyis 'ded mi/ lhor rta dmar khal bkal ba btsun pa zhwa dmar gyon pas 'ded pa/ nub tu drel nag khal bkal ba btsun pa zhwa ser gyon pas 'ded pa/ byang du mdzo rog khal bkal ba grub pa dom ra can gyis 'ded pa/ bzhi ka'ang rgyab tu 'bog 'khur ba/ phyogs bzhi so sor chang bu'am mtheb kyu sha dmar gyis brgyan pa nyer lnga re dkor cha dang bcas pa bshams/

gul yungs rol mo sogs yo byad rnams tshogs par bgyis nas/ mchod gtor rnams la sbyangs bdug bgyis te/ rang lugs phur chung gtor bsngo bskang ba rgyas bsdus ci rigs rdor glu bkra shis smon lam bar grub nas/ glud dkor cha rgyas pa/ sha brgya zan brgya glud len gzugs phyogs bzhi na yod pa dang bcas pa/ sngags drug phyag drug ting nge 'dzin drug gi byin gyis brlabs/ tshig bsangs dpe nas 'byung ba ltar la/ dmigs pa chab gtor sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin/ bsgoms kyang chog de nas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun kyi bka' bden pa dang / gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya chos srung dam can rgya mtsho/ chos nyid gdod nas dag cing chos can rgyu 'bras bslu med bdag cag gi ting 'dzin sngags phyag rgya lhag bsam rnam par dag pa rnams kyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis mchod yul sbyin yul spyi dang / bdag gam sbyin bdag gam/ yul phyogs 'di'i zhes skabs su gang bab smos nas mi phyugs longs spyod la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i sgo nas lus la na tsha/ sems la sdug bsngal/ tshe la bar chad/ bud med dang rigs brgyud 'khor la 'tshe ba/ lo phyugs yo byad la gnod pa sogs mdor na las dang nyon mongs pa las skyes shing lan chags bu lon sha 'khon gnyer ba thams cad zhi ba'i sems dang ldan par gyur nas glud/ dkor nor/ mchod sbyin so so'i mos pa dang mthun pa 'di/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir bzhes pa dang / gdug rtsub zhi phyir len par skad cig thengs cig yud tsam la 'dir gshegs pa dang / 'dus par gyis shig badzra a karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes mdzub mo gnyis bkug pa lan gsum sogs ci rigs byas la/ rnga rol slod kyis blangs te/

sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum bdun brdung / gsum che gcig hūm̐ dang po rgyal byung gang nas byung : dang po phywa yi yul nas byung : de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: mi yul ci mthun de ru babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: bdud las byung ba'i rgyal po de ru babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: bcom ldan thub pa'i dgra bcom de la babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: rgyal po 'khor lo drug pa de la babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: rgyal po kri kri de la babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: rgyal po khri srong lde btsan de la babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: bod kyi rgyal po de la babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: rngon pa mi bdun de la babs: de nas rgyal babs gang du babs: de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag la 'di babs: de ring gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren na: steng gi phyogs nas lha yi dbang po brgya byin yang : rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcings pa khrol: tshig rol gcig gnyis gsum bdun brdungs/ gsum che gcig 'og ma kun la rigs 'gre/ 'og gi phyogs nas spyan 'dren gyi: dga' bo 'jog po la sogs pa: klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bung pa thong la bcings pa khrol: bcom ldan rigs gsum mgon po yang : rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: rgya gar yul gyi rig 'dzin sgrub pa po: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: bal po'i yul gyi rig 'dzin grub pa po: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol:

bod kyi yul nas rig 'dzin grub pa po: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: rol mo gong bzhin/ phyi nang srung ma dam tshig can: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: phyi rdo rje rigs kyi pho nya sum brgya drug cu la: rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: nang rdo rje rigs kyi pho nya sum brgya drug cu yang : rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: g.ya' dang gangs la gnas pa yi: sman dgu la sogs thams cad kyang : rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: yul gyi yul lha gnyen po yang : rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: rol mo gong bzhin/ 'di nas rnga phyir brdungs/ rgyal po sum brgya drug cu yang : rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyang : rgyal gyi gzu dang༞ sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs ra ba gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: bdud po sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa mthong la༞ ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul:

ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs rwab gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: rje bdud lha btsan 'khor dang bcas: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: glud chen bzang po 'di bzhes la: mi bdud dar du ma bsad cig: rta bdud bres su ma bsad cig: g.yag bdud gangs su ma bsad cig: bya bdud gdong du ma bsad cig: rol mo ni tshig rol dgu brdung 'og ma kun la 'gre/ srog bdag srid pa'i rgyal mo yang : rgyal gyi gzu dang dpang la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan༞ bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: byang shar btsan rgod dmar mo yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: nyi zla la sogs gza' chen brgyad: rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa mthong la༞ ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs rwa ba gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs kyang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa༞ ma bsad pa yi glud du 'bul:

ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: smin drug snar ma la sogs pa'i: rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi glud du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: rdo rje legs pa la sogs pa'i: the'u rang sum brgya drug cu yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: ma bdud byang sman rgyal mo yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: lcags mo gangs dkar rgyal mo yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi bu lon du: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: phyogs bcu'i rgyal chen bzhi rnams kyang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la༞ ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: rgyal phran sum brgya drug cu yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du:

'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: brag btsan klu btsan la sogs kyang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: btsan phran sum brgya drug cu yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la༞ ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs rwa ba gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: yul 'di'i yul lha gnyen po yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa mthong la༞ ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: tshig rol dgu brdungs/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu yang : rgyal gyi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: sha brgya zan brgya glud du 'bul: bzung pa thong la bcing pa khrol: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis pa: mthol zhing bshags so bzod par gsol: sha brgya zan brgya'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi: ma bsad pa yi stong du 'bul: ma brkus pa yi 'jal du 'bul: ma chags pa yi bu lon du: 'bul bas khyed kyis bzhes su gsol: mi khyim gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: phyugs rwa ba gang tsam gyi glud du 'bul: chag che nyams nga bzlog tu gsol: su dang 'phrad pa de la bsgyur/ /tshig rol dgu brdungs chems brdung / tshan pa mtha' ma'i/ 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis pa: zhes par slebs pa na mchod g.yog gis glud yas rnams skor rtse lta bu'i snod du sbags la mdos lam 'then la kha bsgyur/

zhes pa'i bar rdzogs rjes phyogs bzhi so so'i snod phyogs su skyel/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab rnga nang bsgyur/ rol mo sum brdeg lan can byas nas bzhag la/ steng yang rdo rje'i bla bre la nas/ bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ bar phur chen bzhin nam/ mi shes na rnga brdung bzhin du: hūm̐/ yang dag ye shes las byung ba'i: sra brtan rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang : rwa ba drwa gur bla bre mos: deng 'dir bar chad kun las srungs: zhes dang tshig rol chems brdungs/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum sogs brjod la sum brdeg lan can rnga rol bzhag nas/ rdor 'dzin dril gsil/ mda' dar g.yab pa'am/ yang na slob dpon gyi rdor dril mda' dar/ gzhan gyi rnga rol bcas bya ba ste srung 'khor steng yang ma'i sne tshan byas nas/ ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyi rjes su rnga rol hod kyis blangs la sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum rnga brdung gsum che gcig srung 'khor rnga rol ma ltar na tshig rol chems brdung sum brdeg lan can rdzogs nas 'theng rkang gsum lnga brdung gsum che gcig de phyin shlau ka re la rol mo sku dang gsung thugs ma yin/ rol mo dkrol skabs slob dpon gyis dril gsil mda' dar g.yab/ oṃ/ rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma yis/ /deng 'dir rgyu 'byor yon bdag gi /tshe srog gzugs can gzugs med kyis/ /khyer ba khug la tshe dbang stsol/ /yi dam mchog gsum lha tshogs kyis/ /deng 'dir rgyu sbyor༞ /tshe srog gzugs༞ /khyer ba khug la༞ /chos srung dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yis/ /deng 'dir rgyu sbyor༞ /tshe srog༞ /khyer ba khug la༞ /lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin gyi/ /deng 'dir rgyu sbyor༞ /tshe srog༞ /khyer ba khug la༞ /nor lha gzhi bdag 'go ba'i lhas/ /deng 'dir rgyu sbyor༞ /tshe srog gzugs༞ /khyer ba khug la༞ /rgyal dang rgyal sras thams cad dang / /khyad par tshe dpag med mgon sogs/ /tshe yi dngos grub stsol ba'i lhas/

/byin rlabs tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /rgya bod mkhas grub ji snyed dang / /bdag gi sngags rgya ting 'dzin dang / /chos srung tshe dbang nor lha yis/ /byin rlabs tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /nyan rang bsgyur rgyal drang srong song / /tshe bsod dpal gyi 'byung gnas kyi/ /lung rtogs yon tan tshe yi bcud/ /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag por stsol/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i bcud/ /nyi zla nor bu dpag bsam shing / /gter bum 'dod 'jo'i ba mchog sogs/ /dngos grub bcud rnams deng 'dir khug /skye 'gro sems can thams cad kyi/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor legs tshogs kyi/ /mthu stobs nus pa kun bsdus la/ /deng 'dir re smon 'grub gyur cig /ces dang rnga rol byas na/ rol mo gong bzhin mthar chems brdung gsum brdeg lan can byas la gtor 'bul rjes chog bya/ yang rbod gtong rbad 'dre'i ngo'i mi nor la god byung ba'am/ 'di dang chabs cig zor byed na gtor bsngo bskang ba'i gtor srung zor gtor dbyibs/ mtshe yungs skyer pa'i rgyan sogs rgyun bzhin byas pa gcig las de'i drung mchod pa sogs gang yang mi dgos/ 'don cha tshang ma gong bzhin la/ glud rdzongs tshar ba'i chems brdung rdzogs nas slar yang dgu brdung gnyis/ rnga phyir brdung de kha'i 'dur/ hūm̐ 'gran bral mthu stobs nus pa'i gter/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma yis/ /zor chen rdzas kyi mthu bskyed la/ /zor mchog 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /rgya bod rig 'dzin mkhas grub sogs/ /byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bla ma yis/ /zor chen rdzas kyi༞ /zor mchog 'di la༞ /yi dam rgyud bzhi'i lha tshogs dang / /khyad par khro bo'i rigs kun gyis/ /zor chen rdzas kyi༞ /zor mchog 'di la༞ /dam can bstan srung ji snyed dang / /khyad par bdag gi chos srung gis/ /zor chen rdzas kyi༞ /zor mchog 'di la༞ /dam ldan rnal 'byor bdag cag gi /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/

/zor chen rdzas kyi༞ /zor mchog 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /tshig rol dgu brdung byas la rnga rol bzhag 'dir bdag bskyed phur chung byas pa'i dbang du btang na/ oṃ badzra kī li sogs brgya stong ci nus/ grangs nges med pa de bzhin rang re'i gtor bsngo chen mo byas pa'i dbang du byas na/ gur lcam dral nas phur srung bar gyi sngags rnams gur lcam dral zhal bcas la gang bzlas kyi phyed gzhan la bzlas mthar/ sum trig rakṣa bhyo: nas/ ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa bar phur bzlog sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin dang / oṃ bha ya sogs gnyis ka nyer gcig tsam bzlas la/ dmigs pa ni bdag mdun lha tshogs thugs ka'i 'od kyis 'khor 'das nus mthu bkug nas zor gtor la thim pas dug mtshon nad yams me dpung sogs gyur par bsam pa ni zor bsgrubs pa'o/ /zor bskul ni gtor ma sgo phyogs su phabs la bsgyur/ rtsam lam 'then/ sgo phye rnga rol hod kyis blangs te/ dgu brdung gnyis rnga phyir brdung gis/ hūm̐ srid zhi'i drag shul kun 'dus pa'i/ /bdag gi gtor zor gnyan po 'di/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /yi dam mkha' 'gros nus pa bskyed/ /dam can srung mas drag por bsgrubs/ /sdang byed dgra la 'phen pa'i zor/ /gnod byed bgegs la 'phen༞ /mthu dang rbod gtong bzlog pa'i zor/ /ngan sngags mnan bsregs༞ /gtor zor mdos sogs༞ /mdo sgrub dmod pa༞ /ngan sham dmag dpung༞ /lha 'dre'i gdug rtsub༞ /nad yams gdon bgegs༞ /'byung bzhi'i gnod pa༞ /ltas ngan mtshan ngan༞ /glo bur ye 'grogs༞ /mo rtsis ngan pa༞ /keg sri ngan pa༞ /dgra jag rkun ma༞ /bsam ngan dug sbyor༞ /log 'dren rigs gyur༞ /bzlog pa'i zor༞ /zor chen rdzas kyi mthu bskyed la/ /mi mthun phyogs kun phyir bzlog cig /nad gdon gdug rtsub ngan gyur kun/ /bstan 'gror gnod pa'i dgra la bhyo: nag phyogs gzugs med bgegs la bhyo: dam can bka' sdod mthu ma chung /

/pho nya las mkhan rtsal ma zhan/ /gtor zor 'bar ba'i shugs drag gi /ngan pa bzlog la rtsub mo rnams/ /dgra dang bgegs kyi dpung la bzlog /ces bskul nas/ tshig rol dgu brdung / yi dam chos srung gi dmag khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa dang / bka' nyan sde brgyad rang rang gzugs kyi 'khor bcas pas bzlog bsad kyi las mdzad par bsam la/ bhyo: bdag la phur pa'i dbal kha gtong ba bzlog: gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa bzlog: gshin rje'i khram kha zug pa bzlog: bon po'i rbad 'dre 'di yis bzlog: mu stegs ngan sngags 'di yis bzlog: pha rol rbad 'dre 'di yis bzlog: sngags pa'i sngags zor 'di yis bzlog: zhang zhung dzo zor 'di yis bzlog: bud med dmod zor 'di yis bzlog: /rgya gar ngan sngags 'di yis bzlog: rgyal nad smyo 'bog 'di yis bzlog: btsan gyi gzer kha 'di yis bzlog: sum pa'i byol zor 'di yis bzlog: klu yi nad rigs gtong ba bzlog: sman gyi bro ra chas pa bzlog: gdag srib spyang ki ngu ba bzlog: dur khrod wa mo brgyal ba bzlog: srin bya lha gong khus 'debs bzlog: 'ug pa ha ha zer ba bzlog: sgo khyi ngu zug byed pa bzlog: nam gung 'og rta mtsher ba bzlog: byis pa'i kha brda ngan pa bzlog: lo keg zla keg 'di yis bzlog: lo sri zla sri 'di yis bzlog: zhag keg za keg 'di yis bzlog: mi kha bra mchu 'di yis bzlog: 'di yis mi bzlog gang yang med: dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' ma bcag: yon bdag 'di yi 'gal rkyen thams cad phyir bzlog cig: tshig rol dgu brdung tshar gsum sogs byas la/ rnga rol bcas spyi 'gre bzhin nam/ yang na rdor dril gsor dkrol kī la ya bzla zhing gtor zor gser skyems sogs khur nas phyi rol ji ltar rigs par gtor ma bzhag rnga rol byas na sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig nas dgu we dgu we gcig zhes bzhag gser skyems thogs la/ hūm̐/ rang nyid yi dam thugs ka nas/

/bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i khro tshogs spros/ /gser skyems bgegs bskrad phud phor dang / /'bru bcud stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur/ /kha dog dri ro nus ldan 'dis/ /'khor 'das mchod yul sbyin yul dang / /khyad par gza' skar sa bdag dang / /gzhi bdag la sogs 'phral yun gyi/ /las la dbang byed thams cad dang / /lan chags dkor long phrag dog can/ /kun kyang gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /mchod yul rnams kyis bdag byin rlobs/ /sbyin yul tshim zhing stong grogs gyis/ /lan chags 'di yis tshim gyur nas/ /rnal 'byor bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /rang rang gnas su 'gro bar gyis/ /zhes dang tshig rol dgu brdung chems brdung gser skyems lan gsum 'thor ba sogs 'dra/ dgu brdung / do nub kyi zor kha gnyan po 'di/ /steng 'og bar la mi zor ro/ /zor lam gnyan po da phyes shig /do nub༞ /phyogs mtshams brgyad la zor༞ /zor lam༞ /do nub༞ /rbad 'dre rbod gtor steng du zor/ /ngan sngags mnan sreg 'phongs la zor/ /dug sbyor dgra jag kun la zor/ /dmag dpung dgra bgegs steng la zor/ /mdor na sdang byed kun la zor/ /zhes dang tshig rol dgu brdung chems brdung gis zor lam phye/ dgu brdung / hūm̐ gang zhig bla ma'i sku dgra dang / /bstan 'gror gnod cing bdag cag dang / /rgyu sbyor yon bdag la rgol ba'i/ /dgra bgegs zhing bcur gyur pa sogs/ /rgyal bas bsgral bar gsungs pa rnams/ /thal ba'i rdul du brlag pa'i phyir/ /zor chen 'bar ba'i gtor ma 'di/ /srid gsum 'joms par mnga' gsol zhing / /rbad cing bskul ba'i las zin pas/ /'gal rkyen bar chad kun bzlog cing / /dgra bgegs srog gi gshed dmar bkye/ /yi dam chos srung dmag tshogs kyis/ /bzlog bsad drag po'i las mdzod la/ /bdud sde thal ba'i rdul du bzlog /tshig rol dgu brdung / bzhi brdung gi zor gtor g.yas g.yon dbus su gsor gsog rgyun bzhin/

byas la gong gi sngags dang / dmod pa skabs su gang bab brjod nas/ bzlog pa gtso bo yin na gtor ma dug mtshon sogs kyi rang bzhin te/ pha rol rbad 'dre sogs la 'phangs pas/ yi dam sogs kyi dmag bgegs de rnams phyi'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol du bzlog par bsam/ bsad pa yin na rgyun gyi zor gzhung gzhan dang mthun gong ltar thu sne rdebs pa sogs byas la/ rnga rol bzhag nas yar 'ong ste gtor snod sgo drung du kha sbub dgra bgegs mi mthun sri ngan thams cad ri rab dang rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan pas bskal pa'i bar du mi ldang bar bsam la/ rnga rol hod kyis blangs nas sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum dgu brdung gcig gnyis gsum zhes bzhag la/ hūm̐ bla ma yi dam chos srung dang / /rnal 'byor bdag gi nus mthu yis/ /dgra bgegs log 'dren mi mthun kun/ /bskal pa'i bar du ma ldang zhig /zhes dang / tshig rol dgu brdung chems brdung bar la/ sarba sha trun bighnān satwaṃ bhā ya nan/ zhes dang / sum brdeg lan can byas la nang du'o/ /srung 'khor tshe bsgrub man gong bzhin no/ /'di yi gzhung la tshig ring thung mi mnyam pa yod kyang gter gzhung yin pas bzo bcos mi bya/ de min tshig khrigs chags bcas kho bos gsar brtsams yin no/ /zhes sha brgya zan brgya'i glud gzhung nag 'gros ma 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros zhes za chog la mnga' brnyes pa des chu 'bum bla ma bsod nams phun tshogs sogs rang dang skal mnyam dkor zan rnams la phan phyir bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 kun dga' blo gros/ sha brgya zan brgya'i glud gzhung srid zhi sbyin mchod/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
